repro_steps: npm audit --omit=dev (evidence/npm-audit-prod.txt); npm view next dist-tags → next-14=14.2.35 (latest 14.x), backport=15.5.25; GET http://localhost:3101/_next/image?url=%2Ffavicon.ico&w=64&q=75 → 200 (optimizer live)
evidence: npm audit: GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 (critical, range >=10.0.0 <15.5.24, Image Optimization API + AVIF), GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36 (critical, windows-hosted — N/A on Vercel Linux), GHSA-c4j6-fc7j-m34r/GHSA-p9j2-gv94-2wf4 (high SSRF), GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3/GHSA-8h8q-6873-q5fj/GHSA-m99w-x7hq-7vfj (high DoS). next.config.mjs:21-40 enables images.remotePatterns ⇒ optimizer is in use; sharp ^0.35.3 is the optimizer backend (package.json).
impact: Unauthenticated RCE class against the deployed image optimizer unless Vercel's platform mitigation covers it; several DoS/SSRF highs.
notes: Needs an OWNER decision: (a) confirm with Vercel whether hosted deployments are mitigated for GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, and/or (b) plan the Next 14→15.5.25 major upgrade, and/or (c) interim: disable AVIF (`images.formats`) / restrict remotePatterns. Not a 15-minute PASS 2 fix. Severity per R9: critical unauth RCE in a used feature = P0 until mitigation is shown.

title: android/app/google-services.json (Firebase config incl. API key) is committed and present in HEAD
repro_steps: git ls-files android/app/google-services.json; git log --diff-filter=A -- android/app/google-services.json → 2242420 2026-08-14
evidence: Blob 72d73eb3 (path android/app/google-services.json) contains 1 AIza-class key (redacted in evidence/secret-scan-history-redacted.txt). Not gitignored (git check-ignore → none).
impact: Firebase Android API keys are designed to ship inside the APK and are not secrets per Google guidance, BUT only if API-key restrictions (Android app package+SHA-1, API restrictions) are set in Google Cloud. If unrestricted, anyone with the repo/APK can bill the project's Places/Maps quota.
notes: Engineering: verify the key's restrictions in Google Cloud Console (owner action; cannot verify from repo). Optionally move google-services.json to CI secrets. Not rotation-critical if restricted.

title: A Google API key was committed inside .claude/settings.local.json in commit c473ade (2026-06-25); commit is reflog-only (no branch/tag), key hash differs from the live GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY
repro_steps: git log --all --reflog --find-object=9364721a6e8fb0e836735e556aacf6072fcf260f → c473ade; git branch -a --contains c473ade → (none); git ls-tree -r c473ade | grep 9364721a → .claude/settings.local.json; sha256(historical key) != sha256(current env key)
evidence: evidence/secret-scan-history-redacted.txt; .gitignore:43 now ignores .claude/settings.local.json. c473ade is not an ancestor of HEAD (d96d06b) nor of production (842379b).
impact: If c473ade was ever pushed to a remote, the key is exposed. It is not the key the app uses today (hash mismatch), so it is either already rotated or a different key.
notes: Owner: confirm the old key is disabled in Google Cloud; run `git reflog expire --expire=now --all && git gc --prune=now` on the shared object store only when no other worktree needs the reflog (97 worktrees share it — do NOT do this casually). Other AIza hits in history are third-party minified bundles (blobs 03bbb967, c974cbe8 — unreachable) and the .env.local.example placeholder; not ours.
